objective: Continue the single-pass native Gemma PLE recurrent adapter from the exact fp32 v10 state on untouched training rows, using stronger matched-donor contrast and a globally fixed larger PLE residual so recurrent state changes cross autoregressive decoding decisions without an inference router.

diagnosis.generation_finding: Correct, zero, donor, shuffled, layer-permuted, and projected-only controls produced identical parsed predictions and scores on one fixed development row per task through an eightfold PLE gain; v10 has teacher-forced CE separation but insufficient learned sequence-level direction.
diagnosis.v1_preflight_finding: Every trainable family was active, but the original all-tensors-nonzero audit rejected 210 dormant inherited RWKV-core tensors before optimizer.step.
diagnosis.v2_preflight_finding: The family-level gradient audit passed, but post-run inspection rejected the checkpoint because its optimizer initial-state hash differed from the v10 final-state hash.
diagnosis.v3_load_finding: The inherited warm-start implementation used detached tensors returned by get_delta_mem_state_dict and copied into those clones rather than model parameters. The corrected loader resolves each key through model.named_parameters, promotes fp32 destinations first, copies all tensors, and verifies the loaded snapshot hash before training.
diagnosis.v4_binding_finding: The continuation changed module constants after import, but the shared trainer had already captured learning_rate=0.0001 and the unrelated parent protocol hash in Python default arguments. The V4 input binding claimed learning_rate=0.000025 while every V4 progress row used 0.0001. The full V4 run was stopped after one update, and V5 passes and audits all protocol-sensitive train arguments explicitly.

training.schedule: Exclude every v10 target and donor row, then apply the locked balanced schedule to remaining training rows.
training.precision_load_order: Resolve actual model parameters by name, promote every fp32 predecessor destination before copying, copy all 1638 tensors, then require the loaded fp32 snapshot hash to equal the v10 final snapshot hash before training.
training.protocol_argument_binding: Pass learning_rate, max_grad_norm, margin, control_weights, and protocol_payload_sha256 explicitly to the shared trainer; reject the result unless every progress row exactly matches these preregistered values.

stopping_rule.development_failure: Do not open final rows; revise the model-side recurrent objective or architecture.
stopping_rule.development_pass: Run the signed expanded paraphrase audit before preregistering a fresh final split.
stopping_rule.final: No final benchmark claim until the preregistered frozen-base and projected-slot comparisons pass without task regression.
